title: K2 Space numbered list
description: Full-width numbered rows in alternating near-black and black bands: a 47.6px number and title on the left, a short 19px paragraph from two thirds of the width, about 230px tall each; phones put the number and title on one line with the paragraph below. A quiet grey link with an arrow closes the list. Each row fades in and rises 15px as it enters.
notes: CSS only; without scroll-timeline support or under reduced motion the rows simply show
